proofs.why: reverts Table W site W4 (the routine child's STDERR handler) to per-chunk redaction: a redactor created and ended inside the handler partitions exactly one chunk, which is what `redactOnly(chunk)` did before ADR-0043. A labelled credential split across a chunk boundary is then scanned as two independent regions, neither of which matches the rule, and the complete key lands in the durable run log — defect WD-SINK-CHUNK-RUNJOB-STDERR. The revert is spelled with `createStreamRedactor` so the failure is an ASSERTION about the log's content, not a ReferenceError.
proofs.replace: child.stderr.on('data', (chunk) => teeWrite(((r, t) => r.push(t) + r.end())(createStreamRedactor(), chunk.toString('utf8')))); /* RP_MUT_RUNJOB_STDERR_PER_CHUNK */
